state.persona_a: Host: visitor who wants to start a trip circle with friends for the Monaco Grand Prix. Not signed in.
state.persona_b: Guest: friend who received a real Circle invitation link /community?circle=<uuid>. Not signed in.
host_path: Home page: event spotlight with link 'Start a Circle here →'

/circles page: 'YOUR SELECTED OCCASION · CURATED CALENDAR — Monaco Grand Prix — Monte-Carlo, Monaco · 04 – 06 Jun 2027 — This is the occasion you chose to plan around. No Circle or booking has been created...' Links: 'Continue in Community to start a real Circle ↗', 'Review event details ↗'. Small print: 'Community requires a connected membership. Enter your travel dates in its Circle form; they are not prefilled here.' Below: sample trip rooms labelled 'Sample trip room — fixture data for the product preview.'

/community page: 'Find your next circle.' Tabs: Travel circles | Partner offers | Your requests. 'Showing circles and offers for your selected event. [Show all destinations]'. 'Make a plan worth sharing.' Card: 'The next great weekend starts with someone. Travel circles will appear when membership is connected. Explore events on the globe in the meantime.' Side card: 'Membership is not connected yet. Profiles, travel modes, circles and partner requests need the membership service...' No Start-a-circle button, no sign-in form, no email field.
state.guest_view: /community?circle=<uuid> shows at top: 'Sign in below to open this Circle invitation. The host approves requests before you can join its private conversation.' Below it the same page as above: 'Membership is not connected yet.' There is no sign-in form anywhere on the page.
